newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FIRST DAY AT CENTURION PARK ABANDONED.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FIRST DAY AT CENTURION PARK ABANDONED.

text.p: A wet pitch forced the opening day of the four-day Supersport Series cricket match between Northern Transvaal and Transvaal to be abandoned without a ball being bowled at Centurion Park on Friday.

Steady rain over the previous three days had left a damp batting surface and, although Friday morning drizzle cleared by 11 a.m., umpires Brian Jerling and Robbie Brooks abandoned play for the day shortly after lunch.
When the pitch was cut and rolled, more moisture was brought up to the surface and play was now set to begin half an hour early on Saturday at 10 a.m.
